description: Default thresholds for torch-trt diffusion models. Per-component cosine similarity is the primary correctness gate (T5 > 0.95, DiT > 0.90, VAE > 0.95). End-to-end PSNR/SSIM are very loose because the C++ pipeline uses a simplified DDIM scheduler (not identical to diffusers DPM-Solver++), so final images will diverge even with identical engines.
